plumbing.review:
One finding needs fixing:

- **[P2] Unescaped component IDs can display false proof status** — [receipt.go:174](receipt.go:174). The resolver accepts a source filename such as `core/x|proved|tail.go`. Its ID is inserted directly into the Markdown table. GFM treats those pipes as column separators even inside backticks, placing `proved` in the Proof column for an **unchecked** component. Escape source-derived IDs for Markdown and add regression coverage for this filename.

The remaining change matches the authorized scope and surrounding Go style. I found no weakened checks, test-specific shortcuts, new network or host access, or secret leakage. Both acceptance test files match the ratified sources, but their ordinary filenames miss this rendering case.

The factory reports all required checks passed in [tests.txt:1](tests.txt:1). I reviewed statically without rerunning tests.

VERDICT: changes needed — escape component IDs in Markdown and cover the false-status rendering case.
